data.title: 户隐憧子 · 把缎带缝好再睡
data.description: 桌灯下，憧子把松开的发饰摊在掌心，低头穿过最后一针。线轴滚到桌沿，她伸出小指轻轻拦住。
data.promptProse: Touko sits at a small desk in a plum cotton lounge dress and cream shawl. She sews the loose seam of a hair ribbon, holding the fabric over her palm while a spool rests near the desk edge. A warm lamp lights the needlework and her lowered gaze.
data.animaCaption: The needle passes through the detached ribbon in her hands, away from her hair.
data.action: 在桌灯下缝好脱线的发饰
